principle: ONE PAGE = ONE PAGE. No fluff inflation (unlike Uncle John's editorial padding). Value is per-page, consistent across all products.
constraint: Every sold page must carry a genuine factoid (history + stream lens + Colonel) or genuine clipart. No filler pages.

catalog.note: Most buyers only arrive in 2026. Pre-2026 = back catalog sold as ONE-TIME volume buys (artwork gathered in the past timeline). 2026+ = subscription (future-timeline works).

single_volume.what: One weekly volume PDF (~217pp: 7 days x 31)

year_as_volumes.what: One year split into 52-53 weekly volumes, bought individually OR as a year set
year_as_volumes.math: 52 x $10 (weekly sub equiv) or 52 x $21.70 a la carte; year-set discounts to ~$10/wk equivalent

three_year_bundle.what: 2020-2022 OR 2023-2025 (three consecutive years) as a complete back-catalog bundle
three_year_bundle.math: 6300pp x $0.05 (bundle discount, half page-value) — rewards bulk, still honest per-page
three_year_bundle.why: Most new buyers (arrived 2026) want the whole origin story cheap. 3-year chunk = the 'origin trilogy'.

complete_back_catalog.why: The collector's shelf. One price, the entire past timeline.

past_timeline.reason: Fixed product. No recurring obligation. Buy the history once.

future_timeline.sells_as: SUBSCRIPTION (2026+ daily issues, volumes, AU, archive)
future_timeline.reason: Ongoing work. Recurring value. Tiers per PRICING.md.

split_doctrine.cross_promo: Back-catalog buyers get 20% off first subscription month (links the one-time + recurring).

self_reference.system: From 2026, stream 'concept' references are tagged by the transcript pipeline. Each new factoid cites its 'pastor' (prior tagged work) so the system builds on itself.
self_reference.use: factoid_engine.py reads concept_tags to cross-link; the subscription (future timeline) surfaces these as 'continued threads'.
